LifeOS v3.2.8 (Build 65):
• Standalone Luna AI Floating Bar: Extracted chatbot launcher into an independent liquid glass capsule beside the main navigation bar
• Minimal Monochrome Luna Icon: Streamlined 8-point geometric speech bubble icon matching system-wide aesthetic without distracting color blobs
• Account-Aware Greeting: Personalized empty state directly welcoming the user with their profile name
• Refined Chat & Settings Interface: Clean liquid glass surfaces with seamless Groq inference and Google Sans Flex typography
